text:
Maya: heads up tiny design review for the routing policies editor. main asks: make priority ordering clearer for keyboard users + non-technical folks, tighten validation copy, and stop the preview simulation from jittering during reorders. quick eyeballs? :mag_right:
Alex: re: ordering affordance 10%: current drag handle is small and the placeholder fades too much. propose: 44px touch target, left-aligned handle, and a thicker ghost row with 3:1 contrast. keyboard reordering needs an aria-live announcement like "Rule X moved to position 2".
Priya: validation copy suggestions: instead of "rule limit exceeded", use "You can pin up to 3 rules. Unpin one to add another." For empty preview: "No simulated results for this traffic. Try expanding filters or add a fallback rule." Short, actionable.
Jo: infra note: reorder currently writes a new snapshot immediately which invalidates sims mid-run 10%. We should either debounce snapshot writes by 500ms or keep sims bound to the snapshot id they started with (snapshot-pin). Prefer pinning so users see stable results unless they explicitly refresh.
Sam: sim UX: surface sampling/determinism state. If sampled, show a seed badge with tooltip and a copyable snippet: 
```
simulate(mode: "sampled", seed: 1234, rate: 0.05)
```
Also add a "Use live traffic" toggle to avoid accidental sampling.
design-bot: a11y checklist (automated):
- ensure drag handle and pin icon have focus styles
- aria-live region for order & validation updates
- contrast failure on pale placeholder (needs darker fill)
- keyboard reorder reachable via Shift+Arrow or Cmd+Arrow
Alex: microcopy tweaks: change CTA `Pin` -> `Pin rule`, `Unpin` -> `Unpin rule`. For priority label show ordinal + adjective: "1 (high)". For non-technical users we can show a subtle horizontal weight bar behind the row. Note: keep hitbox separation.
Priya: love the weight bar idea but language first: show "priority 1 (high)" in the label and use the bar as a visual hint only. Also update error tone: avoid words like "failed" or "invalid" alone; prefer "We couldn't run simulation because you changed the rules. Click to refresh or pin current results."
Jo: implementation constraints: if we add bars, ensure drag handle is at far left with 44px target. Bars must not intercept pointer events. I'll add a CSS pointer-events: none on the bar and enforce left padding for handle. Also will implement snapshot-pin by tying a sim to snapshot_id at start.
Sam: small bug report: timeline in the preview jumps when toggling rule enable/disable. Current backend call is blocking; suggest optimistic client update (fade skeleton row) and background refresh. Add unit test for timeline stability.
Maya: solid. proposed owners: Alex -> microcopy + a11y fixes + figma diff; Jo -> snapshot-pin + pointer hitbox fixes; Sam -> seed badge + optimistic sim flow + tests; Priya -> finalize copy + release blurb. target: tiny release Friday. please react when you pick up. :white_check_mark:
Alex: picking up microcopy & placeholder contrast; will drop Figma diff today.
Jo: taking snapshot-pin + hitbox changes. will verify keyboard reordering behaviour.
Sam: picking up sim optimistic updates and seed badge.
Priya: will polish copy and write the short release note.
Maya: thanks team! i'll follow up in the PR with screenshots. :sparkles:
